study.population: patients with recurrent weight gain after metabolic bariatric surgery
study.intervention: 5:2 intermittent fasting (75% caloric restriction on two days per week)
study.comparator: continuous caloric restriction (25% divided into three meals)

primary_findings.quote: The difference between the two groups remained within the predefined non-inferiority margin of 4 kg (-0.13; 95% CI: -2.90 to 2.62).

primary_findings.outcome: weight change at 12 weeks in IF group
primary_findings.quote: the 5:2 IF group experienced an average weight loss of -1.025 kg (95% CI: -0.09 to -1.96 kg; p = 0.03).

primary_findings.outcome: weight change at 12 weeks in CCR group
primary_findings.quote: The CCR group showed no change in weight at 12 weeks (mean difference -0.88 kg; 95% CI: -2.2 to 3.9 kg; p = 0.51).
